publicProviderEvidence.termsArticle5_5: Public Terms cap ordinary cached Contents at the greater of 7 days, Cache-Control max-age, or an explicit Plan-Term period.
publicProviderEvidence.termsArticle5_6: Public Terms exempt genuine Derived Works from Article 5.5; Derived Work definition requires non-trivial processing and non-reconstructability of individual Contents values.
